title: Set Your Pricing Framework
not_for: Choosing the business model or treating competitor prices as willingness-to-pay evidence.
input_gate: State the value metric, package boundary, and price hypothesis. Do not invent accepted prices when only proposals exist.

packages.fence: One practice and one export format
packages.value_anchor: Illustrative avoided preparation effort, not a measured saving

price_tests.threshold: Two of five qualified prospects accept without permanent discount
price_tests.discount_rule: Temporary pilot credit with explicit expiry

example_note: A test design does not prove this price. Completed pricing analysis may contain hypotheses; observed acceptance needs its own evidence.
failure_case: A negative price, missing billing period, or discount without a boundary fails the record contract.
